newsitem.title: DUBAI: SOCCER-BRAWL BRINGS ABRUPT END TO AUSTRO-RUSSIAN FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRAWL BRINGS ABRUPT END TO AUSTRO-RUSSIAN FRIENDLY.

text.p: A brawl on the pitch forced organisers to abandon a "friendly" match between Russia's Rostselmash Rostov and Austria's Rapid Vienna, officials said on Wednesday.

Fighting broke out between the players after a foul on Rapid player Christian Prosenik, prompting the Austrian side's coach to call his team off the pitch. Scuffles continued as the players headed for the changing rooms.
"We were supposed to have a friendly match that unfortunately ended in an unpleasant way," said an official at Dubai's al-Wasl sports club where the match was held on Tuesday.

Two players were sent off during the match, which ended in a goalless draw. Rapid's Dietmar Kuehbauer was expelled for insulting the referee and spitting at his assistant after being shown a yellow card and a Rostov player got a red card for a crude foul on Prosenik.
"Apart from some bruises here and there, there were no serious injuries," another official said.
The two sides were in Dubai for winter training.
